# n8n_audit (Data Source)

Generates an n8n security audit report. Each read triggers a new audit.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `credentials_risk_report` (String) Credentials risk report as JSON string
- `database_risk_report` (String) Database risk report as JSON string
- `filesystem_risk_report` (String) Filesystem risk report as JSON string
- `instance_risk_report` (String) Instance risk report as JSON string
- `nodes_risk_report` (String) Nodes risk report as JSON string
